tile_title_ar: نسبة التبني الرقمي على المستوى الوطني
colour_rule: Amber fill because 61.2 sits between 55 and 62
what_it_hides_or_reveals: Hides that the measure is non-additive and was averaged across 468 segment rows
teaching_note: SPIN-01. The card is the first thing read and the last thing checked.

tile_title_ar: نسبة التبني الرقمي على المستوى الوطني
chart_type: KPI card with sparkline and distribution strip
colour_rule: Neutral fill; the 65.0 target drawn as a reference line, no traffic light
annotation: User-weighted, per KPI-01. Regional range 50.0% to 67.8%.
what_it_hides_or_reveals: Reveals that one national number covers a 17.8pp regional spread
teaching_note: The measure definition belongs on the tile, not in a data dictionary nobody opens.

colour_rule: Growth bar in brand green, baseline bar in grey
what_it_hides_or_reveals: A 2.16pp rise is drawn as a bar more than twice as tall: lie factor 36.8
teaching_note: SPIN-02. Ask the class to measure the two bars with a ruler before revealing the axis.

colour_rule: Single line; the last nine months drawn in the accent colour
annotation: Slope has fallen from 0.52 to 0.13 pp/month
what_it_hides_or_reveals: Reveals the deceleration that the two-bar version removes by construction
teaching_note: Two points cannot show a trend. Sixty can.

chart_type: Choropleth map, raw digital transaction counts
colour_rule: Sequential green ramp on the raw count
what_it_hides_or_reveals: Population, not performance: the map is a population map with extra steps
teaching_note: Case C. A raw-count choropleth always finds the biggest region.

chart_type: Sorted dot plot, digital transactions per 1,000 residents
measure: SUM(transactions WHERE channel is digital) / population_2025 * 1000
value_shown: Jazan 13 of 13 per capita (7 of 13 by raw volume)
colour_rule: Grey dots; the five Tier-1 regions in the accent colour
what_it_hides_or_reveals: Reveals Jazan falling 6 places once population is in the denominator
teaching_note: Rank shift between the two encodings is the whole Case C lesson.

colour_rule: Brand green, 72pt
annotation: 'More than a third of the population'
what_it_hides_or_reveals: Counts repeat transactions as separate people
teaching_note: SPIN-09. The noun on the tile is the claim.

chart_type: Big number with a secondary figure
colour_rule: Neutral; no colour carries meaning on a count tile
annotation: 1.87 transactions per beneficiary. unique_users is semi-additive - never summed across months.
what_it_hides_or_reveals: Reveals that reach and volume are different questions
teaching_note: Pair every volume number with its denominator.

colour_rule: Red / amber / green arcs at 3.7 / 4.0 / 4.3
what_it_hides_or_reveals: Unweighted average; the needle sits on the amber boundary by accident of method
teaching_note: SPIN-06. A gauge spends a quarter of the canvas on one number and still gets it wrong.

colour_rule: Single bar, target 4.30 as a tick; qualitative bands in light grey
annotation: Transaction-weighted, per KPI-03. Branch CSAT 3.57, Mobile App 4.49.
what_it_hides_or_reveals: Reveals the channel spread behind the single score
teaching_note: Bullet chart: same information, one eighth of the ink.

colour_rule: Green because the number is under the 18 SAR target
what_it_hides_or_reveals: The excluded branch channel is the entire cost problem
teaching_note: SPIN-13. The filter is real, documented nowhere, and decisive.

chart_type: KPI card plus a small multiple by channel
colour_rule: Neutral card; 18 SAR target as a reference line on the small multiple
annotation: All channels included. Branch 51.6 SAR, Mobile App 4.14 SAR.
what_it_hides_or_reveals: Reveals that the saving comes from moving volume, not from cheaper delivery
teaching_note: Any filter that changes the answer belongs in the title.

measure: Adoption projected on the full-window slope
colour_rule: Dashed green projection, no interval
what_it_hides_or_reveals: Fits the trend from the fastest-growing start month available
teaching_note: SPIN-03. The start month is a choice; make the class find it.

measure: Adoption projected on the nine-month slope, with the full-window slope shown for contrast
filter_applied: last nine months for the primary fit
colour_rule: Grey band between the two scenarios; target line at 65
what_it_hides_or_reveals: Reveals that the projection is a choice of window, and shows both
teaching_note: Show the uncertainty you created by choosing.

measure: Region adoption vs a green line set at 62.0
colour_rule: Green at or above 62.0, amber 55.0-62.0, red below 55.0
what_it_hides_or_reveals: Uses the amber line as the green line; the 65.0 target never appears
teaching_note: SPIN-07. Colour with no printed threshold is an assertion, not evidence.

chart_type: Sorted bar chart with the target line
measure: Region adoption vs threshold_green from kpi_targets.csv
value_shown: 4 of 13 at or above 65.0; 9 below target
colour_rule: Diverging scale centred on the 65.0 target, thresholds printed on the axis
annotation: Thresholds read from kpi_targets.csv: red 55.0, amber 62.0, green 65.0
what_it_hides_or_reveals: Reveals how far below the line each region is, not merely that it is
teaching_note: Bind thresholds to the governance file at build time.

colour_rule: Madinah highlighted, the rest grey
what_it_hides_or_reveals: Rebasing deletes the level: the leader is 8 of 13 on the actual measure
teaching_note: SPIN-10. Index charts always flatter whoever started lowest.

chart_type: Dot plot of current level with a connector to the 2021 baseline
measure: Region adoption, level and change together
colour_rule: Grey connectors, current-value dots coloured against the 65.0 target
annotation: Index 210.3 on a 2021-07 = 100 base; level 62.1%, 2.9pp below target
what_it_hides_or_reveals: Reveals level and change in one mark, so neither can hide the other
teaching_note: If you index, print the base value.

tile_title_ar: حصة القنوات الرقمية من تقديم الخدمة
colour_rule: Two-segment donut, digital in brand green
what_it_hides_or_reveals: Removes the 2,467,819 branch transactions the programme exists to move
teaching_note: SPIN-11. A donut hides the denominator twice: by shape and by filter.

tile_title_ar: حصة القنوات الرقمية من تقديم الخدمة
measure: Transactions by channel as a share of all transactions
colour_rule: Four ordered channel colours, branch at the top where the change is visible
annotation: Denominator = all four channels. Branch alone is 19.8% of volume.
what_it_hides_or_reveals: Reveals the residual branch volume and how slowly it is falling
teaching_note: Composition questions need the whole whole.
